named-native-query.name: EsqSubtreeRow.subtreeFromOrg
named-native-query.query: WITH RECURSIVE org_subtree AS ( SELECT o.org_pk AS pk , o.org_et_pk AS kind , o.org_name AS name , o.org_desc AS d , o.org_org_pk AS parent_pk , p.ep_path AS path_str , 1 AS lvl FROM esq_org o JOIN esq_entity_path p ON p.ep_pk = o.org_pk WHERE o.org_pk = CAST(:seedId AS bigint) AND p.ep_path LIKE :rootPath || '%' UNION ALL SELECT o.org_pk , o.org_et_pk , o.org_name , o.org_desc , o.org_org_pk , p.ep_path , t.lvl + 1 FROM esq_org o JOIN esq_entity_path p ON p.ep_pk = o.org_pk JOIN org_subtree t ON o.org_org_pk = t.pk WHERE p.ep_path LIKE :rootPath || '%' ) SELECT CAST(pk AS TEXT) AS id , pk AS entity_id , kind AS kind , name AS name , d AS "desc" , CAST(parent_pk AS TEXT) AS parent_id , lvl AS lvl , path_str AS entity_path FROM org_subtree UNION ALL SELECT CAST(u.usr_pk AS TEXT) , u.usr_pk , u.usr_et_pk , u.usr_name , u.usr_desc , CAST(u.usr_org_pk AS TEXT) , t.lvl + 1 , p.ep_path FROM esq_user u JOIN esq_entity_path p ON p.ep_pk = u.usr_pk JOIN org_subtree t ON u.usr_org_pk = t.pk WHERE p.ep_path LIKE :rootPath || '%' AND u.usr_deleted_flg = 'N' UNION ALL SELECT CAST(a.acc_pk AS TEXT) , a.acc_pk , a.acc_et_pk , a.acc_id , a.acc_desc , CAST(a.acc_usr_pk AS TEXT) , t.lvl + 2 , p.ep_path FROM esq_account a JOIN esq_user u ON a.acc_usr_pk = u.usr_pk JOIN esq_entity_path p ON p.ep_pk = a.acc_pk JOIN org_subtree t ON u.usr_org_pk = t.pk WHERE p.ep_path LIKE :rootPath || '%' ORDER BY lvl DESC, parent_id NULLS LAST

named-native-query.name: EsqSubtreeRow.subtreeFromUsr
named-native-query.query: SELECT CAST(u.usr_pk AS TEXT) AS id , u.usr_pk AS entity_id , u.usr_et_pk AS kind , u.usr_name AS name , u.usr_desc AS "desc" , CAST(u.usr_org_pk AS TEXT) AS parent_id , 1 AS lvl , p.ep_path AS entity_path FROM esq_user u JOIN esq_entity_path p ON p.ep_pk = u.usr_pk WHERE u.usr_pk = CAST(:seedId AS bigint) AND p.ep_path LIKE :rootPath || '%' UNION ALL SELECT CAST(a.acc_pk AS TEXT) , a.acc_pk , a.acc_et_pk , a.acc_id , a.acc_desc , CAST(a.acc_usr_pk AS TEXT) , 2 , p.ep_path FROM esq_account a JOIN esq_entity_path p ON p.ep_pk = a.acc_pk WHERE a.acc_usr_pk = CAST(:seedId AS bigint) AND p.ep_path LIKE :rootPath || '%' ORDER BY lvl DESC, parent_id NULLS LAST

named-native-query.name: EsqSubtreeRow.subtreeFromAcct
